subject.title: [Feature]: Talk/Voice tab — agent/session switching + per-agent TTS voice

question: Should the remaining Talk/Voice agent/session selector land Android-first using existing gateway agent/session state, or wait for a shared companion-app Talk/Voice UX direction?
rationale: Current main solves per-agent TTS but not Talk/Voice target selection, and the remaining work changes user-visible session routing across companion-app voice surfaces.

options.title: Android-first Talk selector
options.body: Add a bounded Android Voice/Talk selector using existing gateway agent/session state while keeping agents.list[].tts as the only per-agent voice config path.

options.title: Shared companion-app design first
options.body: Pause implementation until maintainers define one Talk/Voice selection model for Android, macOS, and future companion apps.

options.title: Close as config-only solved
options.body: Close the issue and treat agents.list[].tts as sufficient, leaving Talk/Voice target selection out of scope.

recommendation.title: Android-first Talk selector
recommendation.body: Add a bounded Android Voice/Talk selector using existing gateway agent/session state while keeping agents.list[].tts as the only per-agent voice config path.

likelyOwner.reason: They implemented and documented the TTS half and already scoped the remaining issue to Talk/Voice session selection.
